name: ctrl2phone
description: Capture any area of your screen with Double Ctrl, send it to Gemini Web or directly to your phone via Supabase.

scripts.start: npm run build && npm run build:native && electron .
scripts.build:native: cd src && "%WINDIR%\Microsoft.NET\Framework64\v4.0.30319\csc.exe" /nologo /reference:System.Windows.Forms.dll /target:exe /out:key_listener.exe key_listener.cs && "%WINDIR%\Microsoft.NET\Framework64\v4.0.30319\csc.exe" /nologo /reference:System.Windows.Forms.dll /reference:System.Drawing.dll /target:winexe /out:pill_hud.exe pill_hud.cs && "%WINDIR%\Microsoft.NET\Framework64\v4.0.30319\csc.exe" /nologo /reference:System.Windows.Forms.dll /reference:System.Drawing.dll /target:winexe /out:photo_dropper.exe photo_dropper.cs && "%WINDIR%\Microsoft.NET\Framework64\v4.0.30319\csc.exe" /nologo /target:exe /out:round_window.exe round_window.cs
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run build:native && electron-builder

author: Eren
